facts.fact: Konoom, a N'Djamena fintech launched in 2025, offers an e-wallet for money transfers, merchant payments and bill payments by mobile app, web, USSD and WhatsApp, per We Are Tech Africa.
Konoom is said to allow transfers between e-wallets, bank accounts and agent networks, per We Are Tech Africa.

TCD.note: No tax or fee payment channel stated.
